observedIn: synthetic replay of 2026-10-12 (project card replay, cases P8 and the standing-role case), deepseek-flash, temperature 0; the first wording of the card's instruction wrote a population, an intervention and an endpoint for the bleeding question of the 'standing-role-and-focus' case in 3 of 3 samples, the second in 1 of 3, the final one in 0 of 16
whyItIsWrong: Nothing was wrong before the card existed; the case holds the line the card must not cross. A researcher asking what two published trials found has not described a study of their own, and the card is the researcher's description of it: the elements of the question (a drug, an age group, an endpoint) are the topic of the conversation, not the shape of a project. Filing them would put a trial's population on a project card as if it were the project's.
expected: No project_fact, decision or follow_up is written, and no key of the project card.

messages.text: ARISTOTLE 试验里阿哌沙班相对华法林的大出血结果是怎样的？再帮我对比一下利伐沙班的 ROCKET-AF。
ARISTOTLE 中阿哌沙班的大出血显著少于华法林；ROCKET-AF 中利伐沙班与华法林大出血相近，颅内出血较少。两项试验人群与设计有差异，需谨慎横向比较。
